title: Two-Feature Experiment

model_a.Features: Type, Air temperature [K], Process temperature [K], Rotational speed [rpm], Torque [Nm], Tool wear [min]

interpretation_note: The two-feature model is a feature-reduction experiment. A lower score does not automatically mean it is inferior for every industrial use case. Compare failure recall, precision, false negatives, false positives, and operating costs as well as overall accuracy.
limitations: The split is a random stratified split, not a chronological split.
AI4I 2020 does not provide a real maintenance-action history.
Results depend on the split and model configuration.
The default threshold of 0.50 is not necessarily cost-optimal.
